notes: This leaf continues scan 141's compactness paragraph, cancels an attempted converse, and treats (iii)⇒(iv) through characters and Galois actions. The field lattice and character-lattice diagram are retained with their written inclusion signs. The text defines G using Gal(Ktilde/K), while its margin labels G on the Ktilde/Q connection; both labels remain. It also writes H in the final trivial-action sentence, after P in the preceding one. Check 143.N1: for the finite set I_K, the map from the free abelian group on P-orbits to Z[I_K], sending an orbit basis element to the sum of its members, identifies Z[P\I_K] with Z[I_K]^P: invariant coefficients are constant on each orbit and the orbit supports are disjoint. This checks the displayed invariant-module identity only; it supplies no proof of the full compact-torus argument. The new diagonal inclusion in the diagram follows its curved ink, not an inferred arrow. Archive number 142.
